text: Remote work has kind of completely changed modern office work. On top of the flexibility for work and family, companies like being able to choose talent form wherever it may be, on top of the reduction of cost. But its not perfect. Communicating is difficult, teams feel disconnected or fragmented over time. People also become isolated, the wall between work and home gets blurred. And I think how it works out is all to do with having good policies or expectations. But mostly the challenge is keeping the human touch when everyone is digital.
